archetypes.name: mav-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 3 MAV control flow is stateful and phase-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new design-step3-mav.sh wrapper for phase ordering, result-env precedence, pause handling, tally-error handling, and loop-vs-single mode routing. Check that trusted KV frames cannot be spoofed by rendered scope-anchor or ballot content. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: mav-harness
archetypes.rationale: The new harness and prose pins guard a migrated prompt-to-wrapper boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether test-design-step3-mav.sh and test-step3-orchestrator-fence.sh pin the important integration risks without depending on brittle local paths. Check Makefile and relevant-checks routing for complete coverage of new and changed files. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
